{{Top|leg}}
'''Star Tours Flight 193''' was the designation of a flight offered to passengers by the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency around the time of the [[Battle of Death Star III]]. It was scheduled to arrive from [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] at Gate 12 at the time, but was late.

*[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] {{1stm}} {{C|Tokyo only}}
